summary_1line: Arjuna recounts Indra, disguised as a golden bird, persuading misguided ascetics to abandon premature renunciation and uphold household duties and Vedic rites.

image_candidates.scene_text: Indra disguised as a radiant golden bird perches before a group of young forest ascetics, speaking while they listen among the trees.
A cluster of youthful Brahmana ascetics in the forest look up in surprise at the shining golden bird addressing them.
The golden bird rebukes the ascetics amid a quiet woodland hermitage scattered with simple huts and ritual fires.
